title.en: Electric field and electric field lines
title.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ರೇಖೆಗಳು

heading.en: A charge changes the space around it

hook.en: Bring a tiny test charge anywhere near a charged ball and it feels a push, without any contact. We describe that push per coulomb, at every point, as the electric field.
hook.kn: ಆವೇಶಗೊಂಡ ಚೆಂಡಿನ ಬಳಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಆವೇಶವನ್ನು ತಂದರೆ, ಸ್ಪರ್ಶವಿಲ್ಲದೆಯೇ ಅದು ಬಲವನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಕೂಲುಂಬ್‌ಗೆ ಇರುವ ಆ ಬಲವೇ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ.

objectives.en: Define electric field and find it for a point charge.
Draw and read electric field lines.

narration.en: Bring a tiny test charge anywhere near a charged ball and it feels a push, without any contact. We describe that push per coulomb, at every point, as the electric field.
narration.kn: ಆವೇಶಗೊಂಡ ಚೆಂಡಿನ ಬಳಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಆವೇಶವನ್ನು ತಂದರೆ, ಸ್ಪರ್ಶವಿಲ್ಲದೆಯೇ ಅದು ಬಲವನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಕೂಲುಂಬ್‌ಗೆ ಇರುವ ಆ ಬಲವೇ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ.

body.en: The electric field at a point is the force per unit positive test charge placed there: $\vec E = \vec F/q_0$. Its SI unit is N C⁻¹ (the same as V m⁻¹). For a point charge Q the field points away from a positive charge and towards a negative one, with magnitude $kQ/r^2$. A charge q placed in a field feels $\vec F = q\vec E$. The field of several charges is the vector sum of their fields.
body.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಎಂದರೆ ಏಕಮಾನ ಧನ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಆವೇಶದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬಲ; ಏಕಮಾನ N C⁻¹. ಬಿಂದು ಆವೇಶಕ್ಕೆ E = kQ/r². ಧನ ಆವೇಶದಿಂದ ಹೊರಕ್ಕೆ, ಋಣ ಆವೇಶದತ್ತ ಒಳಕ್ಕೆ. ಆವೇಶ q ಮೇಲಿನ ಬಲ F = qE.

points.en: Force on q: F = qE (opposite to E for negative q)

narration.en: Electric field is force per unit positive charge, measured in newton per coulomb. For a point charge it is k Q by r squared, pointing away from a positive charge and towards a negative one. A charge q in the field feels a force q E.
narration.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಎಂದರೆ ಏಕಮಾನ ಧನ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಆವೇಶದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬಲ; ಏಕಮಾನ N C⁻¹. ಬಿಂದು ಆವೇಶಕ್ಕೆ E = kQ/r². ಧನ ಆವೇಶದಿಂದ ಹೊರಕ್ಕೆ, ಋಣ ಆವೇಶದತ್ತ ಒಳಕ್ಕೆ. ಆವೇಶ q ಮೇಲಿನ ಬಲ F = qE.

title.en: On the board: field of a point charge

narration.en: Put a tiny test charge q₀ near a charge Q: the force on it per coulomb is the electric field E. For a point charge E is kQ over r squared: away from a positive charge, towards a negative one. The field falls off as one over r squared, so it weakens quickly with distance. Field lines start on positive charges and end on negative charges. Two lines never cross and never close into loops; crowded lines mean a strong field.

say.en: Put a tiny test charge q₀ near a charge Q: the force on it per coulomb is the electric field E.
For a point charge E is kQ over r squared: away from a positive charge, towards a negative one.
The field falls off as one over r squared, so it weakens quickly with distance.
Field lines start on positive charges and end on negative charges.
Two lines never cross and never close into loops; crowded lines mean a strong field.

body.en: A field line is a curve whose tangent at every point gives the direction of the field there. Lines start on positive charges and end on negative charges (or go to infinity). Two lines never cross, since the field has only one direction at a point. Electrostatic field lines never form closed loops. Where lines are crowded the field is strong; where they spread out it is weak.
body.kn: ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಧನ ಆವೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭವಾಗಿ ಋಣ ಆವೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ. ಅವು ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಛೇದಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಕುಣಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ದಟ್ಟವಾದ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಪ್ರಬಲ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Tangent gives the direction of E
Start on +, end on −; never cross
Density of lines ∝ strength of E

problem.en: Find the electric field 30 cm from a point charge of +5 nC in air.

steps.en: Q is positive, so E points away from the charge.

answer.en: 500 N C⁻¹, directed away from the charge

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the electric field 30 cm from a point charge of +5 nC in air.

problem.en: An electron is placed in a uniform field of 2 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹. Find the force on it and its acceleration (mₑ = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg).

steps.en: F = eE = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ × 2 × 10⁴ = 3.2 × 10⁻¹⁵ N, opposite to E.

answer.en: 3.2 × 10⁻¹⁵ N opposite to E; about 3.5 × 10¹⁵ m s⁻²

narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡವು ಮೆಲ್ಲನೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two competitive exam pattern questions. Read carefully, then choose.

points.en: Point charge: E = kQ/r², away from + and towards −.
points.kn: ಬಿಂದು ಆವೇಶ: E = kQ/r², ಧನದಿಂದ ಹೊರಕ್ಕೆ, ಋಣದತ್ತ ಒಳಕ್ಕೆ.

points.en: Fields of many charges add as vectors.
Field lines go from + to −, never cross, never close.
points.kn: ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಧನದಿಂದ ಋಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಮುಚ್ಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

homework.en: Sketch the field lines of (a) two equal positive charges and (b) a +q and −q pair.

narration.en: Recap. E = F/q₀; unit N C⁻¹. Point charge: E = kQ/r², away from + and towards −. Fields of many charges add as vectors. Field lines go from + to −, never cross, never close.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. E = F/q₀; ಏಕಮಾನ N C⁻¹. ಬಿಂದು ಆವೇಶ: E = kQ/r², ಧನದಿಂದ ಹೊರಕ್ಕೆ, ಋಣದತ್ತ ಒಳಕ್ಕೆ. ಅನೇಕ ಆವೇಶಗಳ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳು ಸದಿಶವಾಗಿ ಕೂಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಧನದಿಂದ ಋಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ, ಛೇದಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಮುಚ್ಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
